about_the_game:
Sling-A-Thing is a mind-boggling, laugh-out-loud, comedy action puzzler that will keep you entertained for hours. Dive into a whimsical world where you can transform into an incredible variety of cartoon characters and objects, all to find your way to the exit in the most creative ways possible.

Features:

Quirky, Surprising & Satisfying Gameplay
Every level is designed to surprise you with quirky challenges and satisfying solutions. The humor and creativity packed into each puzzle make every moment enjoyable.

Over 200 handcrafted Levels to Conquer
With more than 200 unique levels, there’s always a new challenge waiting for you. Each level presents different obstacles and puzzles that will test your wit and reflexes.

Transform into Over 20 Different Things
One of the most exciting features of Sling-A-Thing is the ability to transform into more than 20 different characters and objects. From quirky creatures to everyday items, each transformation offers unique abilities that help you navigate through the puzzles. Heart and ghost, anvil and sun, Turtle and turd, the combinations are endless!



Original Transformation Mechanic
The transformation mechanic is truly original, allowing you to think outside the box. You’ll need to strategize which transformation to use and when, making the gameplay both challenging and fun!
Prepare for a delightful adventure with Sling-A-Thing! It’s the perfect blend of comedy and puzzle-solving action, ensuring an experience you won’t forget. Sling! Transform! Laugh!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel or AMD Quad Core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 970 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 550 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Sling-A-Thing is a comedy action puzzler, where you throw and transform into more than 20 different cartoon characters and objects to find your way to the exit in over 200 levels! Transform into a bat, an anvil, a ghost, a lovely heart, a baseball, a rocket, a UFO, a rubber duck and many more!
